verdict.rationale: Zapier offers a Workflow API and an SDK CLI that let you authenticate and execute actions/stored-actions directly from a terminal or script (zapier-docs-26, zapier-docs-27, zapier-docs-29, zapier-docs-23), which supports headless/programmatic invocation suitable for CI-style automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI pipeline integration, non-interactive triggers, or examples of running Zaps end-to-end without the web UI. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration guides, evidence of non-interactive full workflow execution (not just single stored actions), and independent confirmation of headless use in production pipelines.
